methods.name: vectorization
methods.description: Each parameter set ˆθi is vectorized into a single vector.

methods.name: k-means clustering
methods.description: Performed over all vectorized parameter sets ˆθi to return centers and proportions of class membership.

methods.name: reverse vectorization
methods.description: Used to convert the parameter set Θ(0) back to the original parameter sets.

methods.name: k-means
methods.description: used to determine an initialization for VISTA

methods.name: LGSSM fitting
methods.description: fit from each initialization, the one generating the largest log-likelihood is chosen

methods.name: VISTA
methods.description: develops model parameters further than the k-means initialization

methods.name: previous_mixture_LGSSM_clustering_approach
methods.description: implemented in Python, building from the EM implementation introduced in [55]

methods.name: Kalman filter
methods.description: Used to compute ˆ xi,l k|j, Ωi,l k, and Ωi,l k,k−1 for each time series i.

methods.name: RTS smoother
methods.description: Used to compute ˆ xi,l k|j, Ωi,l k, and Ωi,l k,k−1 for each time series i.

methods.name: EM algorithm
methods.description: Performed with M-step updates until termination based on the sum over the absolute difference between parameter sets.
